Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own. It enables developers to: - Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs. - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems. - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer. - Expose: serve context to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. # 闲鱼智能监控系统

[中文] ｜ [English](README_EN.md)

基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控，提供完整的 Web 管理界面。

## 核心特性

- **Web 可视化管理**: 任务管理、账号管理、AI 标准编辑、运行日志、结果浏览
- **AI 驱动**: 自然语言创建任务，多模态模型深度分析商品
- **多任务并发**: 独立配置关键词、价格、筛选条件和 AI Prompt
- **高级筛选**: 包邮、新发布时间范围、省/市/区三级区域筛选
- **即时通知**: 支持 ntfy.sh、企业微信、Bark、Telegram、Webhook等多渠道
- **定时调度**: 支持 Cron 配置周期性任务
- **账号与代理轮换**: 多账号管理、任务绑定账号、代理池轮换与失败重试
- **Docker 部署**: 一键容器化部署

## 截图

![监控概览](static/img.png)
![任务管理](static/img_1.png)
![结果查看](static/img_2.png)
![通知推送](static/img_3.png)

## 🐳 Docker 部署（推荐）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor && cd ai-goofish-monitor
cp .env.example .env
vim .env # 填写相关配置项
docker compose up -d
docker compose logs -f app
docker compose down
```

如果镜像无法访问或下载速度慢，可尝试使用加速：
```bash

docker pull ghcr.nju.edu.cn/usagi-org/ai-goofish:latest
docker tag ghcr.nju.edu.cn/usagi-org/ai-goofish:latest ghcr.io/usagi-org/ai-goofish:latest
docker compose up -d

```

- 默认 Web UI 地址：`http://127.0.0.1:8000`
- Docker 镜像已内置 Chromium，无需宿主机额外安装浏览器。
- 官方镜像地址：`ghcr.io/usagi-org/ai-goofish:latest`
- 更新镜像：`docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`
- 如果你修改了 `.env` 中的 `SERVER_PORT`，请同步更新 `docker-compose.yaml` 里的端口映射。
- `docker-compose.yaml` 默认会把 SQLite 主库挂载到 `./data:/app/data`，数据库文件默认为 `data/app.sqlite3`
- 目前默认持久化这些目录：
    - `data/`  SQLite 主存储（任务、结果、价格历史）
    - `state/`  登录状态 cookie 文件
    - `prompts/`  任务提示词
    - `logs/`  运行日志
    - `images/`  商品图片与任务临时图片目录
    - `config.json`、`jsonl/`、`price_history/`  首次升级到 SQLite 时用于兼容导入的旧数据源

### 数据存储与迁移

- 当前在线主存储为 SQLite，默认路径 `data/app.sqlite3`
- 可通过环境变量 `APP_DATABASE_FILE` 自定义数据库路径；Docker 默认设置为 `/app/data/app.sqlite3`
- 应用启动时会自动建库建表，并尝试从旧的 `config.json`、`jsonl/`、`price_history/` 导入一次历史数据
- `state/`、`prompts/`、`logs/`、`images/` 仍然是文件系统目录，不在 SQLite 中
- 商品图片会临时落到 `images/task_images_<task_name>/`，任务结束后默认会清理
- 首次升级完成并确认 `data/app.sqlite3` 中数据正确后，可视部署方式决定是否继续保留旧的 `config.json`、`jsonl/`、`price_history/` 挂载

| 变量 | 说明 | 必填 |
|------|------|------|
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` |

**Who this is for:**
- **Founders and CEOs** — especially technical ones who still want to ship
- **First-time Claude Code users** — structured roles instead of a blank prompt
- **Tech leads and staff engineers** — rigorous review, QA, and release automation on every PR

## Quick start

1. Install gstack (two pastes, about 30 seconds of setup; see below).

--- Octomind is an open-source coding agent harness. It gives any LLM the tools to work in a repository — read and edit files, run shells, search code, delegate to sub-agents — through [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io), and runs the result as an interactive CLI, a stdin pipe, a daemon, a WebSocket server, or an ACP agent in your editor. Most agents stop and ask a human before each risky step, which works at a keyboard and blocks everything in CI. Octomind writes that policy down as TOML guardrails and adds a supervising model that plans and checks the work, so the same session can run with nobody watching.

Go Music DL 是一个多平台音乐搜索与下载工具，支持 **Web**、**TUI** 和**桌面端**，覆盖单曲、歌单、专辑、排行榜与本地音乐。它同时暴露了一套 AI 可调用的接口——**AI 可以直接操控你正开着的网页播放器**，点歌、切歌、暂停、调音量都不用你动手，详见 [AI / Agent 调用](#ai--agent-调用)。 ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 桌面端 / 移动端 从 [Releases](https://github.com/guohuiyuan/go-music-dl/releases) 下载对应安装包： - Windows / Linux / macOS：从 Releases 下载 `music-dl-desktop-rust` 或 `music-dl-desktop-go` 对应平台包，解压后直接运行。 - Android：优先下载 `music-dl_arm64-v8a.apk`，已内置 FFmpeg，无需额外安装。 - iOS：使用 `music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa` 自行签名。 ### Web / TUI ```bash # Web，默认访问 http://localhost:8080/music ./music-dl web # 挂载到反向代理二级目录 ./music-dl web --base-path /dl # 终端搜索 ./music-dl -k "周杰伦" ``` Web 的搜索、试听、下载和歌单浏览无需登录；修改设置或 Cookie 时才需要管理员账号。首次配置时，启动日志会打印 `Web setup token`，用它创建管理员账号即可。TUI 常用键：`↑/↓` 移动、`空格` 选择、`a` 全选、`r` 换源、`Enter` 下载、`w` 每日推荐、`q` 退出。 ### Docker ```bash docker compose up -d --pull always --remove-orphans ``` 访问 `http://localhost:8080`。首次启动会自动创建 `./data` 并配置好容器写权限；Compose 不依赖仓库里的 Dockerfile 或其他文件，只需 `docker-compose.yml` 和镜像即可启动。修改源码后可使用 `docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build` 本地构建。 ### AI / Agent 调用 Web 服务提供 AI 能力索引和播放器控制接口。搜索、歌单、专辑、排行榜、歌单分类、换源、歌词、下载和本地音乐等能力全部复用现有的 `/music/*` 接口，不再维护第二套 AI 包装路由。 ```bash # 搜索歌曲，只请求 QQ 和网易云 curl "http://localhost:8080/music/search?q=周杰伦&type=song&sources=qq&sources=netease" ``` API 索引：`http://localhost:8080/music/api/ai/index`，精简说明：`http://localhost:8080/music/llms.txt`。索引会列出可直接复用的现有搜索、详情、排行榜、歌单分类、换源、下载和本地音乐接口，以及新增的播放器控制接口。 #### AI 可以直接操控网页播放器 只要浏览器里开着本站页面，AI 就能**远程操作这个页面**：点歌、切歌、暂停、调音量、拖动进度，全部靠一条 HTTP 请求完成。不需要浏览器自动化、不需要模拟点击、也不需要接管你的鼠标键盘。 原理是页面自己维持着一条 SSE 长连接（`GET /music/api/ai/player/events`）：AI 把命令 POST 到服务端，服务端推给在线的页面，页面执行后把播放状态回传。所以 AI 看到的 `playing`、`position`、`current` 都是页面的真实状态，而不是猜测。 典型对话：**“帮我放一首 ClariS 的歌”** → AI 调 `/music/search` 找歌 → 调 `/api/ai/player/play` 点播 → 轮询 `/api/ai/play

#

Pocket ID
Pocket ID is an easy-to-use OpenID Connect Certified™ and OAuth 2.0 provider that lets users sign in to your applications with passkeys. → Try out the [Demo](https://demo.pocket-id.org) The goal of Pocket ID is to be a simple and easy-to-use. There are other self-hosted OIDC and OAuth 2.0 providers like [Keycloak](https://www.keycloak.org/) or [ORY Hydra](https://www.ory.sh/hydra/) but they are often too complex for simple use cases. Additionally, what makes Pocket ID special is that it only supports [passkey](https://www.passkeys.io/) authentication, which means you don’t need a password. Some people might not like this idea at first, but I believe passkeys are the future, and once you try them, you’ll love them. For example, you can now use a physical Yubikey to sign in to all your self-hosted services easily and securely. ## Setup Pocket ID can be set up in multiple ways. The easiest and recommended way is to use Docker. Visit the [documentation](https://docs.pocket-id.org) for the setup guide and more information. ## Contribute You're very welcome to contribute to Pocket ID! Please follow the [contribution guide](https://github.com/pocket-id/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started. # Kero

A terminal for coding agents, on macOS, Windows and Linux.

Run Claude Code, Codex, a dev server or a test watcher each in its own session. Kero groups sessions by project in a sidebar that shows which are working, which need you and which are done.

- **Sessions outlive the window.** They run in `kerod`, a small daemon, so quitting Kero leaves them running. Reopen it and every pane and its scrollback is back.
- **Status at a glance.** Each pane is working, waiting, idle, error or exited. <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>J</kbd> jumps to the one that needs you, and Kero notifies you when an agent finishes, fails or is blocked.
- **A CLI agents can drive.** `kero` starts sessions, splits panes, types into them, waits on them and reads their screens.
- **Remote hosts.** Run agents on a Linux box, a cloud VM, a Mac, a Windows PC or WSL and see them in the same sidebar, over SSH or Tailscale. They keep running when your laptop sleeps. See [Remote Hosts](docs/remote.md).
- **Ghostty under the hood.** Terminals render with libghostty, so Ghostty themes, fonts and config keys just work.

## Install

Download Kero from the [releases page](https://github.com/egoist/kero/releases), then choose **Kero › Install Command Line Tool…** to put `kero` on your `PATH`.

```sh
kero new -n fix-login -- claude
```

To run sessions on a Linux server, a Mac or a Windows PC, install the server build there, then add the machine in **Settings › Hosts**:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/egoist/kero/releases/latest/download/install-server.sh | sh
```

On Windows, in PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/egoist/kero/releases/latest/download/install-server.ps1 | iex
```

See the [docs](docs/index.md) for more.

## Prior art

- [**Rex**](https://www.superlogical.com/rex/docs/installation): Mitchell Hashimoto's terminal and multiplexer in one native app, with sessions that persist through a server and a scriptable CLI.
- [**Herdr**](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr): a terminal multiplexe

> **Need more features?** [RustDesk Server Pro](https://rustdesk.com/pricing.html) might suit you better.
>
> **Want to develop your own server?** Start with [rustdesk-server-demo](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk-server-demo), a simpler starting point than this repository.

## How to build manually

```bash
cargo build --release
```

Three executables will be generated in target/release.

- hbbs - RustDesk ID/Rendezvous server
- hbbr - RustDesk relay server
- rustdesk-utils - RustDesk CLI utilities

You can find updated binaries on the [Releases](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk-server/releases) page.

## Configuration

`hbbs` and `hbbr` can be configured with command-line flags, environment
variables, or an `.env` / config file. Run `hbbs --help` or `hbbr --help` to see
the available flags.

The most common options:

| Option | Flag | Env var | Applies to | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Key | `-k` | `KEY` | hbbs, hbbr | `hbbs` loads/generates one by default |
| Bind address | `-b` | `BIND` | hbbs, hbbr | Local IP address to listen on (default: all interfaces; requires 1.1.17+) |
| Port | `-p` | `PORT` | hbbs, hbbr | Listening port (hbbs `21116`, hbbr `21117`) |

# scriptc

scriptc compiles TypeScript and JavaScript to native executables and WebAssembly. It uses the types checked by the TypeScript compiler to generate machine code, and the output runs without Node.js installed. npm packages your program imports compile along with it. Code scriptc can't compile is reported at build time with a diagnostic and, where available, a rewrite hint. scriptc is experimental and supports a subset of JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js APIs. -   Nested build job invocations

-   Pluggable architecture
